(Capacity: 1,012) |champion = |tourney= |tourney_result = }} {{2023–24 Big Sky men's basketball standings}} The '''2023–24 Sacramento State Hornets men's basketball team''' represented [[California State University, Sacramento]] in the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by second-year head coach [[David Patrick (basketball)|David Patrick]] and played their home games at the [[Hornets Nest (Sacramento State)|Hornets Nest]] as members of the [[Big Sky Conference]]. == Previous season == The Hornets finished the season 14–18, 7–11 in conference play to finish in sixth place. In the [[2023 Big Sky Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Sky tournament]], the Hornets lost their quarterfinals game against [[2022-23 Weber State Wildcats men's basketball team|Weber State]]
